paite: Huai khit in Joshua in Reuben pawlte, Gad pawlte leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte asam hi.
heading: Joshua In Suahlam Namte A-inn Uah Asawl
english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

paite: Akiang uah, "TOUPA sikha Mosi in hon thupiak peuhmah na zuita ua, ke'n thu ka hon piak peuhmah leng na zuita uhi.
english: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

paite: Tuni tanpha in na unaute uh na taisan kei ua, TOUPA na Pathian un hih dia thu ahon piak na zuita uhi.
english: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of Yahweh your God.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un akiang ua ana gensa bang in, na unaute uh muanna apeta hi. Huaiziak in TOUPA sikha Mosi in Jordan gal a na tantuam ding ua hon piaksa gam ah, na puanin kaihte uah pai nawnta un.
english: Now Yahweh your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan.

paite: TOUPA sikha Mosi in TOUPA na Pathian uh it a, alampi tengteng tawn a, athupiakte zui a, amah len tinten a, na lungtang tengteng uleh na kha tengteng ua amah nna sem chiatchiat dia hon thupiakte, huai thupiak leh dante pilvangtak in limsak un," achi hi.
english: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”

paite: Joshua in amau avualzawl a, apaisakta hi. Huchi in apuanin lam uah apaita uhi.
english: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.

paite: Manasseh nam kimkhatte Mosi in Bashan gam ah tantuam apia a; akimkhat dangte Joshua in tumlam pang ah Jordan gal ah a-unaute lak ah tantuam ape zawta hi. Joshua in a-inn lam ua apaisak dek lai in avualzawl hi.
english: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,

paite: Akiang uah, "Na puanin lam uah hauhsakna tamtak toh paita unla, ganta tampi toh, dangka toh, dangka-eng toh, dal toh, sik toh, silh-le-ten tampi toh. Na melmate ua pan na gallakte uh unaute toh kihawm dialdial un," achi hi.
english: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”

paite: Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte akik nawn ua, Kanaan gam Shiloh a pan Israel suante kiang a pan Gilead gam, TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu a na piak bang in amau tantuam ding mawng a sehsa gam a pai ding in apawtkheta uhi.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Kanaan gam a Jordan gamgi ava tun un Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Jordan lui gei ah maitam lianpi kholang mahmah khat adoh uhi.
heading: Jordan Pang A Maitam
english: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

paite: Ngai in, Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Kanaan gam chin tak, Jordan gamgi, Israel suante gam lam pang ah maitam adoh uh, chih Israelte kiang ah kuahiam khat in ava hilh hi.
english: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”

paite: Israel suante'n hiai thu azak un, Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng amaute dou tum in Shiloh ah akikhawm uhi.
english: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

paite: Israel suante'n Gilead gam a Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang ah siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas asawl uhi.
english: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.

paite: Milian sawmkhat, Israel nam a inkuan a lupente'n Phinehas azui uhi.
english: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.

paite: Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang Gilead gam ah ahoh ua, akiang uah,
english: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

paite: huchi in TOUPA mi omkhawm tengteng in, "Bangziak a tuni a TOUPA tung a hel tum a maitam doh a, TOUPA lehngatsan na hi ua?" achi uhi.
english: “The whole congregation of Yahweh says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following Yahweh, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against Yahweh?

paite: "Peor mun a tatsiatnate, ei a dia neu lua a sim theih ahi maw? Tuni tan in leng huai a i khelhna ua pan silsiang i hi nai kei ua, TOUPA mi omkhawmte lak ah hipi alen tanpha in leng.
english: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of Yahweh,

paite: Tuni a TOUPA lehngatsan na tup maizen uh? Huchi in tuni in TOUPA tung ah na na helta maimah ua, zingchiang a zaw Israel mipi omkhawm tengteng tung a amah heh ding ahita ve.
english: that you must turn away today from following Yahweh? It will be, since you rebel today against Yahweh, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

paite: Na gam luah uh siang lou ahihleh, TOUPA gam, TOUPA biakbuk omna mun ah hong pai unla, ka lak uah hong teng un. Himahleh TOUPA i Pathian un achih louh maitam dang bawl in TOUPA tung ah hel kei unla, kou tung ah leng hel kei un.
english: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of Yahweh, in which Yahweh’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against Yahweh, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than Yahweh our God’s altar.

paite: Zer tapa Akan in hamsiat thil ah ana hihkhial a, Israel mipi tengteng tung ah hehna ahong om ahi kei maw? Huai mi tatsiatna ah amah kia amangthang tuam kei hi," achi uhi.
english: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”

paite: Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Israel nam a intekpente adawng ua, akiang uah,
english: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

paite: "TOUPA, pathiante' Pathian, pathiante TOUPA Pathian in athei. Israel pawl in leng thei hen! Ka maitam doh uh TOUPA lehngatsan a, hel tupna hiam thilhihkhelh tupna hiam a ka hih uleh, tuni in leng hon hawi kei un,
english: “The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, the Mighty One, God, Yahweh, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against Yahweh (don’t save us today),

paite: halmang thillatna ding hiam, nek ding thillatna ding hiam, lemna thillatna ding hiam ahihleh, TOUPA mahmah in thukhen hen.
english: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following Yahweh; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let Yahweh himself require it.

paite: Tunung chiang in na suante un ka suante uh kiang ah, Nou TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian na zat phakna uh bang om ahia?
english: “If we have not out of concern done this, and for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, “What have you to do with Yahweh, the God of Israel?

paite: Nou Reuben suante leh Gad suante aw, TOUPA'N kou leh nou a ding in Jordan gamgi ding in abawl hi. TOUPA ah tantuam na nei sam kei uh, ahon chi kha ding uh, chi a, pilvan ziak a aziak neitak a ka hih uh ahi. Na suante un kou suante TOUPA laudan thei lou in abawl kha thei uhi.
english: For Yahweh has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in Yahweh.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in kisa un, maitam i bawl ding uh, halmang thillatna ding leh kithoihna ding bel hilou in.
english: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;

paite: Kou leh nou leh i nung ua i suante kikal ah theihpihna ahi dia, huchi in ka halmang thillatte uh leh ka kithoihnate uh leh ka lemna thillatte ua TOUPA nna ka septheihna ding uh leh na suante un leng tunung chiang a ka suante uh kiang a TOUPA ah tantuam na nei sam kei uh ahon chihlouhna ding un, ka chi ua ahi.
english: but it will be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of Yahweh before him with our burnt offerings, with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings;’ that your children may not tell our children in time to come, ‘You have no portion in Yahweh.’

paite: Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, tunung chiang a ka kiang uh hiam, ka suante uh kiang uh hiam a huchibang a ahon chih chiang ua kou, 'En ve ua, ka pipute un TOUPA maitam abawl uh omdan, halmang thillatna ding leh kithoihna ding ahi kei a, kou leh nou kikal a theihpihna ahi zaw hi,' ka chihna ding ua, ka hih uh ahi.
english: “Therefore we said, ‘It shall be, when they tell us or our generations this in time to come, that we shall say, “Behold the pattern of Yahweh’s altar, which our fathers made, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.”’

paite: TOUPA tung a hel a TOUPA lehngatsan a, TOUPA ka Pathian uh maitam, abiakbuk chin a maitam kia lou halmang thillatna ding hiam, nek ding thillatna ding hiam, theihpihna ding hiam a maitam bawl ka hihlouhdan uh," achi uhi.
english: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against Yahweh, and turn away today from following Yahweh, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides Yahweh our God’s altar that is before his tabernacle!”

paite: Siampu Phinehas leh akiang a omkhawmte' miliante, Israel pawl nam intekpente'n Reuben suante leh Gad suante leh Manasseh suan kimkhatte thugen azak un akipaksak mahmah hi.
english: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.

paite: Siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas in Reuben suante leh Gad suante leh Manasseh suan kimkhatte kiang ah, "TOUPA tung a thil na hihkhelh louh ziak un, tu'n zaw TOUPA i lak ua om ngeina ahi, chih ka theita ve ua. Huchi in Israel suante TOUPA khut a pan na hunkheta uh," achi uhi.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that Yahweh is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against Yahweh. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of Yahweh’s hand.”

paite: Huchi in siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas leh milian pawl, Reuben suante leh Gad suante a pan leh Gilead gam a pan Kanaan gam ah Israel suante kiang ah akik nawnta ua, thu ava tun nawn uhi.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

paite: Huai thute'n Israel suante akipaksak mahmah a; Israel suante'n Pathian aphatta uh. Huchi in Reuben suante leh Gad suante dou a, atenna gam uh suksiatsak ding in kuankhiak atum nawn kei uhi.
english: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.

paite: Reuben suante leh Gad suante'n huai maitam pen, "theihpihtu,” achi uhi. "TOUPA, Pathian a na hi ngei chih i kikal ua theihpihtu ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that Yahweh is God.”
